newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - PaineWebber ups Sofamor.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - PaineWebber ups Sofamor.

text.p: -- PaineWebber analyst Charles Olsziewski confirmed he upgraded Sofamor Danek Group Inc to buy from attractive.

-- He said the company, in announcing Monday that it would post a $50 million pre-tax charge in its 1996 results from product liability lawsuits, had "identified the worse-case" scenario on the product liability front.
-- He estimates the company will earn $2.03 a share in 1997 and $2.40 in 1998. He has a $48 12- to 18-month price target on the stock.
